summary: Keep historical MinerPass economic queries and Go validation consistent across activation intervals
details: Economic RPCs select raw settlement, effective contribution, level and difficulty-factor contracts at the requested BTC height. Historical registry queries require equivalence throughout the indexed prefix, rejecting intermediate divergences even when the final active versions match.
Leaderboard caching now checks the durable branch as well as height. Candidate and collab pagination retains the exact historical registry and height and rejects continuations from a replaced branch.

Go checks the full registry prefix before constructing a current mining selector. Shared Rust-generated HTTP RPC vectors exercise independent Go derived-value validation and tamper rejection; additional formulas are restricted to isolated conformance builds and are rejected by ordinary binaries.

Production remains schema v1, state machine v2 and existing energy formulas. Public activation records, identity encodings and exact dataset bindings are unchanged; this does not enable in-place registry migration.
